source: Collected on the shared box from read-only Docker, HTTP and GitLab Rails checks: sudo docker ps, sudo docker inspect, sudo docker image inspect, sudo docker stats --no-stream, sudo docker exec gitlab (VERSION, version-manifest, gitlab-ctl status, gitlab-rails runner for runner metadata without credentials), sudo docker exec gitlab-runner (gitlab-runner --version, gitlab-runner verify), curl of http://localhost:8929 /-/health /-/readiness /-/liveness /users/sign_in and /api/v4/version, and a redacted parse of /workspace/gitlab-docker/runner-config/config.toml. Setup notes from /workspace/gitlab-docker/README.md and docker-compose.yml. No container was started or restarted. Credential file contents and runner authentication values were not read into this page.
not_collected: /api/v4/version (unauthenticated HTTP 401); version taken from the VERSION file instead

sources.gitlab_image: sudo docker image inspect of the GitLab image id
sources.runner_image: sudo docker image inspect of the runner image id
sources.gitlab_version: sudo docker exec gitlab cat /opt/gitlab/embedded/service/gitlab-rails/VERSION and head -1 /opt/gitlab/version-manifest.txt
sources.gitlab_ctl: sudo docker exec gitlab gitlab-ctl status
sources.runner_verify: sudo docker exec gitlab-runner gitlab-runner verify
sources.runner_toml: parsed /workspace/gitlab-docker/runner-config/config.toml after stripping credential assignments; those values were not stored
sources.rails_runner: sudo docker exec gitlab gitlab-rails runner (Ci::Runner id, description, runner_type, tag_list, run_untagged, online, status, locked, contacted_at, created_at)
sources.password_file: tested only whether /workspace/gitlab-docker/config/initial_root_password exists; file contents were not read
sources.compose: read /workspace/gitlab-docker/docker-compose.yml and README.md for setup notes
